calculate_average_overlap: calculate the average overlap metric between predicted and ground truth rankings
calculate_partial_average_overlap: calculate the normalized partial average overlap metric between predicted and ground truth partial rankings with ties
build_partial_ranking_matrix: build a partial ranking matrix from ranking and group arrays to express ties between classes
calculate_average_overlap_single: calculate the average overlap metric for a single ranking pair
calculate_partial_average_overlap_single: calculate the normalized partial average overlap metric for a single partial ranking pair
